NOTIFICATIONS BY HEADS OF DEPARTMENTS, ETC.
JUDICIAL NOTIFICATION
COURT OF SMALL CAUSES, CHENNAI - 104.
Destruction of Records
(Dis.No. 4881/2026)
No.VI(1)/451/2026.
It is hereby notified that the records in the cases mentioned in the Annexures to this Notification are ripe
for destruction.
Therefore, the Litigants and the concerned Counsels on record are hereby informed to ascertain and to inform
the facts regarding the pendency of appeal, settlement of award, if any with regard to the cases mentioned in
the Annexure within one month from the date of this Notification, failing which the said records will be destroyed

without any further notice.
